text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan's Arab Potash to issue GDRs (Global Depositary Receipts) worth an estimated $50 million to finance ambitious expansion schemes to raise production.
- Prime Minister Majali says Jordan stands by Egypt in its efforts to relaunch peace process.
- Trade minister says Jordan looks forward to forging closer economic ties with Egypt.
- Leading Palestinian poet Mahmoud Darwish to open Jerash festival's poetry recital evenings on July 23.
- King Hussein meets Qatari Emir in London; talks touch on Qatari decision to go ahead with preparations to hold Doha Middle East Economic Summit.
- Trade minister denies any intention to raise price of cement, saying move would affect exports.
- Prime Minister Majali visits Tunis on Wednesday to boost bilateral ties.
- Egyptian Foreign Minister Moussa says his country rejects attempts to sow dissension in ties with Jordan.
- Police make largest drug bust in history of Jordan.
